description: Brand end card for ads and promos: the brand word bounces in letter by letter, a tagline lands on a colour block, an optional call-to-action pill and small sparkles; holds still for reading, no exit (the cut ends it). Over a calm, slowed shot or a solid colour.

params.cta: Call to action pill, e.g. 'Available now' (optional)
params.sparkles: true to add a few sparkles (default true)
params.ink: Text on the tagline block and pill, default #111111
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output
